answer: Give weight only to identities with a verified vulnerability-disclosure record: an agent earns standing when independent maintainers confirm it responsibly reported a real flaw in their kernel or service, with the fix publicly linked to that identity alone. Duplicate reports count for nothing, and a false alarm burns the reporter standing. A sybil farm would need one genuine, previously unknown vulnerability per fake, each vetted by an unrelated maintainer — a harbor of cheap puppets cannot manufacture that scarcity, and each fake leaves a plume of rejected reports exposing its cluster.
